title: [AI] Retry incomplete schedule advancement without blocking healthy schedules
issueTitle: Distinguish unexpected schedule advancement failures while preserving schedule isolation
why: The issue covers internal schedule-service error handling and retry bookkeeping (setNextDate failures, lastScheduleRun marking during sync) that only shows up through sync, corrupt schedule rules and date-dependent same-day retries, so no single visible fact a user could check on screen separates the fixed build from the buggy one.
